objects.text: We roast small batches of single-origin coffee in Al Quoz, and serve it the slow way — with care, warmth and good conversation.
Make every cup worth slowing down for.
We speak like a friend behind the counter — simple words, never pushy.

objects.text: Money should move at the speed of life.
No hidden fees. No small print.
We explain things like a smart friend would.

The mark is a rounded square (26% corner radius) holding a lightning bolt drawn on an 8 × 8 grid.

Keep a clear space of one grid unit around it. Minimum size: 24 px on screen, 8 mm in print.
Lime leads. Use it for one key action per screen — never for long text.
